theme.rationale: Targeting FAANG recruiters and startups requires an ultra-professional, high-trust, and accessible design. We use strict white space, strong red accents for interaction, and a highly structured layout mimicking premium tech dashboards.

buttons.primary: bg-[#E53935] text-white font-semibold py-3 px-6 rounded-full hover:bg-[#C62828] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 shadow-sm hover:shadow-[0_4px_14px_rgba(229,57,53,0.39)]
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#111111] border border-[#E5E7EB] font-semibold py-3 px-6 rounded-full hover:border-[#111111] hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all duration-300
buttons.floating_action: fixed bottom-6 left-6 z-50 bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-300 group flex items-center gap-2 overflow-hidden

cards.default: bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] transition-shadow duration-300
cards.interactive: bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-2xl p-6 hover:border-[#E53935] cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-300 group

inputs.text: w-full bg-white border border-[#E5E7EB] text-[#111111] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E53935] focus:border-transparent transition-all duration-200 placeholder:text-[#888888]

badges.skill: px-4 py-2 bg-[#FFEBEE] text-[#E53935] rounded-full text-sm font-semibold

navbar.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E5E7EB]
navbar.links: hidden md:flex gap-8 text-[#555555] hover:text-[#E53935] font-medium transition-colors duration-200

hero.structure: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 items-center min-h-[90vh] pt-20
hero.image_container: relative w-72 h-72 sm:w-96 sm:h-96 rounded-full overflow-hidden border-8 border-white shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]

projects.featured: col-span-1 md:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8 items-center bg-[#FAFAFA] rounded-3xl p-8 border border-[#E5E7EB]

admin_dashboard.sidebar: w-64 bg-white border-r border-[#E5E7EB] flex flex-col
admin_dashboard.table: bg-white border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm w-full

motion.page_load: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
motion.typing_animation: Use react-type-animation library for professional cursor blinking effect in the Hero intro text.
motion.progress_bars: initial={{ width: 0 }} whileInView={{ width: 'target%' }} transition={{ duration: 1, ease: 'easeOut' }}

accessibility.contrast: All text colors strictly meet WCAG AA contrast ratios against #FFFFFF background.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, links MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-hire-me-button').
accessibility.focus_states: All focusable elements must have visible focus rings: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E53935]

hero_portrait.description: Professional Software Engineer Portrait - Clean, light background

project_placeholder_1.description: Dashboard Web App Interface for Project Thumbnail

project_placeholder_2.description: Clean Analytics Interface for Project Thumbnail

abstract_background.description: Premium white abstract lines for subtle section backgrounds (opacity 5-10%)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the portfolio strictly using Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and React Type Animation.
Do NOT implement dark mode. Ensure all classes remain explicitly in the light theme palette provided.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for Headings and Satoshi for body. Apply tracking-tight to headings.
For the Skills section, build animated progress bars that load sequentially using Framer Motion when scrolled into view.
Floating Action Button: Place at bottom-left. It should feature a WhatsApp icon that expands horizontally on hover to show other social links.
The Hero section must contain exactly 4 buttons: Hire Me (Primary red), View Projects (Secondary outline), Download Resume (Secondary), and View Resume (Secondary).
Admin Dashboard: Build a basic CRUD interface (Table, Sidebar, Forms) imitating the 'WorldOfSMM' professional utility layout. Use Shadcn UI tables if needed, but match the #E53935 accents.
Include `data-testid` on EVERY button, link, and form input.
